title: SoFT: Soft Targets for Generalizable LLM Fine-Tuning
abstract: arXiv:2609.32493v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Distillation enables student language models to acquire new capabilities from expert teachers. However, integrating knowledge from multi-teacher, multi-domain demonstrations into a single student remains challenging. We study supervised fine-tuning (SFT) in this setting, where students must acquire diverse capabilities while maintaining generalization beyond the training tasks. Our experiments reveal varying trade-offs between in-distribution learning and out-of-distribution generalization across SFT methods, motivating more explicit control over this balance. To this end, we propose soft-target fine-tuning (SoFT) to balance learning from teacher demonstrations with retaining the Base model's existing capabilities. SoFT sets a minimum target probability for each demonstrated token while making the smallest KL change to the Base distribution. translated_title: SoFT：面向可泛化大语言模型微调的软目标方法
translated_abstract: 蒸馏使学生语言模型能够从专家教师处习得新能力。然而，如何将来自多教师、多领域演示的知识整合到单个学生模型中仍然具有挑战性。我们在这一设定下研究监督微调（SFT），即学生模型必须在习得多样化能力的同时，保持超越训练任务的泛化能力。我们的实验揭示了不同SFT方法在分布内学习与分布外泛化之间存在不同的权衡，这促使我们对这种平衡进行更明确的控制。为此，我们提出软目标微调（SoFT），以在从教师演示中学习与保留基础模型现有能力之间取得平衡。SoFT为每个演示token设定一个最小目标概率，同时对基础分布做出最小的KL散度改变。由此得到的目标函数将从演示中学习与自适应加权……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出软目标微调方法SoFT，通过为演示token设定最小目标概率并对基础模型分布做最小KL改变，在多教师多领域蒸馏场景下平衡新能力的习得与模型的分布外泛化。
en_tdlr: SoFT balances learning from multi-teacher, multi-domain demonstrations with out-of-distribution generalization by setting a minimum target probability per demonstrated token while making the smallest KL change to the base model's distribution.
